Order under Section 223 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Ordinance to be read with Section 2 of the ProvincialCouncils (Consequentional Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989

I, Dharmasiri Dasanayake, The Chief Minister of North Western Province and Minister of Finance and Planning, EngineeringServices, Law and Order, Local Government and Provincial Administration, Economic, Promotion, Power and Energy,Enviornmental Affairs, Water Supply and Drainage and Tourism Affairs do hereby notify that following order in terms ofSection 223 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of year 1987 which reads with the Section 2 of the ConsequentionalProvisions of Provincial Councils Act, No. 12 of year 1989.

DHARMASIRI DASSANAYAKE,The Chief Minister of North Western Province andMinister of Finance and Planning, Engineering Services,Law and Order, Local Government and Provincial Administration,Economic, Promotion, Power and Energy, Enviornmental Affairs,Water Supply and Drainage and Tourism Affairs.At Kurunegala,on the 29th of January 2016.
1. This Order is cited as “Order of enforcing Budget Document for the year 2016 as Pradeshiya Sabhas' in NorthWestern Province”

2. In case of Budget Document relating to the year 2016 could not be passed in certain Pradeshiya Sabhas withinthe North Western Province in terms of provisions stipulated in Section 168 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act it islawful for relevant to Pradeshiya Sabhas to enforce for the year 2016 the draft Budget formulated for 2016under the approval of Commissioner of Local Government in North Western Province.
3. This Order shall be in force with effect from 01.01.2016.
